# WO-2026-08-13-13 — the Cockpit write path

**Mum's Cockpit is live and her SEND button honestly says it cannot send. Your job is to make that
sentence false by making the sending real — not by deleting the sentence.** Felix is wiring her button
in parallel under WP-B15-49; you own everything behind the wire.

## THE ROUTE CONTRACT — **AMENDED v2, 2026-08-13.** Frozen, and byte-identical in the other lane's order.

> **⚠️ v2 SUPERSEDES v1 IN PLACE. If you read v1 before this edit, re-read this block — three things changed.**
> Keel's read-back established that v1 instructed the UI to tell Mum her list was sent at the exact moment
> nothing whatsoever happened. That is the failure the contract existed to prevent, and it was mine.

```
Cockpit (tailnet)   POST /api/asdair/list
   proxies to →     POST http://127.0.0.1:8710/asdair/list

request  { "household": 1,
           "items": [ { "id": "<regulars.id_display>", "name": "<the name SHE was shown>", "qty": 1..20 } ] }

200      { "ok": true, "shop_ref": "...", "shop_id": <n>,
           "created": true|false,
           "matched_by": "insert"|"shop_ref"|"telegram_message"|"superseded_terminal_ref" }

4xx/5xx  { "ok": false, "error": "<machine_code>", "message": "<ONE plain sentence>" }
```

**AMENDMENT 1 — `matched_by` carries the STORE'S OWN vocabulary, passed through VERBATIM.** v1 invented
`"created"|"shop_ref"|"inbound"`; `shopStore.createOrResumeShop` actually returns
`'insert' | 'telegram_message' | 'shop_ref'` and can also return `superseded_terminal_ref`. **Build no
translation layer** — a renamed enum is a place for the two sides to drift, and the invented word `inbound`
described nothing. `telegram_message` is **structurally unreachable from the Cockpit** (both Telegram keys
are null on every submission Mum makes); it stays in the type because the store can return it, and its
appearance would be a real bug worth seeing rather than a case worth hiding.

**AMENDMENT 2 — `ok:true` ALONE NEVER LICENSES THE WORD "SENT". This is the load-bearing one.**

- `created:true`  → a shop row was written. **The sent state is permitted.**
- `created:false` → the day's shop already existed and **this submission changed NOTHING durable.**
  **The UI MUST render this DIFFERENTLY from a successful send** — in substance: *"Today's list has already
  gone. This didn't change it."* **It must NOT say her list was sent, and it must NOT claim her change
  landed.**

*Why: `receiveList` is idempotent on `(household_id, shop_ref)` and `shop_ref` is `'SHOP-' + date`. A second
submission the same day resumes the existing shop and writes nothing — no shop row, no command row, no
event. v1's sentence "her UI may only say the list was sent when `ok:true`" was satisfied by exactly that
no-op. Addendum E criterion 9 names this precise defect: "any answer that changes the display but not the
durable record."*

**AMENDMENT 3 — `note` is REMOVED from the request.** S2 (add something else in her own words) is not built
and its control is deliberately disabled, so there is no UI that can produce free text. An always-empty
field would be a small lie about a capability that does not exist. **Send no `note` key at all.**

## Acceptance criteria

**AC1 — `receiveList` is on the command surface, and the deny list still bites.**
Add `receiveList` to `COMMAND_NAMES` in `commandSurface.js`. This is the ONE capability extension
Addendum C §5 named, and Warwick has authorised it. **Prove the deny list is unweakened by executing
it**: `isForbiddenName` must still refuse `checkout`, `payNow`, `book_slot`, `submitOrder`. A test that
asserts the array literal is not proof — call the function.

**AC2 — a Cockpit intake adapter, and it is an ADAPTER.**
New `services/asdair/cockpit-api/cockpitIntake.js`. Addendum C §5 names the anti-pattern explicitly:
*"building a Cockpit intake service. The moment a second module owns list intake, `pollIntake`'s
translator layer has been copied rather than joined."* Your model is `runtime.js:116-146` — the Telegram
translator — and yours is the same shape with `actor: 'cockpit:mum'`, `sourceKind: 'text'`, the three
`telegram*` fields left unset, and `rawText` carrying a deterministic plain-words rendering of her
selection so the raw evidence is retained as `receiveList` promises. **It implements no shopping logic.**

**AC3 — `POST /asdair/list` on cockpit-api, and `POST /api/asdair/list` proxied by the Cockpit.**
`services/cockpit/server.mjs` proxies GET only today; add the POST. Body-size cap it like the existing
POST routes do. **A proxy failure must return the JSON error shape above, never a bare text 502** —
Felix's UI has to distinguish "did not send" from "sent", and a text body makes that impossible.

**AC4 — THE RESEND IS HONEST, and this is the criterion most likely to be got wrong.**
`receiveList` is idempotent on `(household_id, shop_ref)` and `shop_ref` derives from the date. So a
second submission on the same day **resumes the existing shop and writes no new one**. Addendum B §9.5
promises her *"I want to change something"* returns the page to editable **and re-sends**. Those two
facts collide. **Establish by execution what a second POST actually does, report it exactly, and return
`created:false` with the true `matched_by`. Do NOT invent a mechanism to make the second send change the
list** — if her correction genuinely does not land, that is a finding for Larry, not work for you.

**AC5 — proved through the real production modules, not a fixture.**
Start a cockpit-api process yourself against the disposable Postgres, POST a real list at the real HTTP
route, then **SELECT the row back from a SEPARATE process**. A shop that only exists inside the writing
process's own return value is the "it worked in the demo" defect Addendum E criterion 9 exists to catch.
Paste the actual SQL and the actual row.

**AC6 — `/asdair/health` stops lying about binding.**
Addendum C §5 names the second anti-pattern: `command_surface_bound` today means *a file exists on disk*
(`require.resolve` succeeds without evaluating). It must mean **dispatch would work**. Fix it, and
**mutation-test it** — make it fail on purpose and show the failure, or it is not a check.
